name: Chinese SimpleQA
abstract: Chinese SimpleQA focuses on Chinese factual question answering. This page uses the F-score reported in the paper.
contributions: The benchmark targets Chinese factuality rather than transferred English knowledge.
The page uses F-score to balance answer correctness and completeness.
method: Chinese SimpleQA is the first comprehensive benchmark for factual short-form question answering in Chinese, designed to measure how reliably models answer concise fact-seeking questions.
It covers 6 broad topics and 99 subtopics, and combines strict quality control, static reference answers, and short QA pairs to keep evaluation reliable and reproducible.
The paper uses the benchmark to compare existing LLMs and further studies the effects of model scale, calibration, RAG, and alignment on Chinese factuality.
The results show that Chinese factuality rankings do not simply mirror English leaderboards, so Chinese-facing models still require dedicated evaluation and optimization.
leaderboard_note: The primary leaderboard uses F-score. For factuality benchmarks, this metric is more stable than a single raw accuracy number.
